text.en: This Order may be cited as the Fisheries (Amendment) Order, 2010. of section 3 7 of S 25/09.

Section 37 of the Fisheries Order, 2009 is amended, in subsection (lJ, by deleting "15( 1}," from the third line. Made this 6th. day of Syawal, 1431 Hijriah corresponding to the 15th. day of 2010 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM PENGIRAN HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI WlJAYA HAJI AHMAD, Pemangku Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam. B$5.00
